governing product returns, refunds, replacements, exchanges, and compensation requests. 
The policy aims to: 
• Protect customer rights.

DELIVERY SERVICE LEVEL AGREEMENT (SLA) POLICY 
Document Title: Delivery Service Level Agreement (SLA) Policy 
Document Owner: Logistics Operations Department 
Effective Date: June 2, 2026 
Review Frequency: Annual or as required by business changes 
 
1. PURPOSE 
The purpose of this Delivery Service Level Agreement (SLA) Policy is to establish 
standardized service commitments, operational expectations, delivery timelines, 
accountability measures, escalation procedures, and performance monitoring requirements 
governing the fulfillment and delivery of customer orders. 
This policy serves as the authoritative reference for logistics teams, customer support teams, 
warehouse operations personnel, delivery partners, technology systems, and automated 
decision-making agents responsible for order fulfillment and customer experience 
management. 
The objectives of this policy are to: 
• Ensure consistent delivery performance. 
• Define measurable delivery standards.

• Customer support operations. 
• Automated fulfillment systems. 
• AI-powered operational agents. 
The policy applies from the moment an order is confirmed until successful delivery, 
cancellation, return, or closure. 
 
3. DEFINITIONS 
3.1 Order Confirmation 
The point at which payment authorization is completed and the order is accepted for 
processing. 
3.2 Fulfillment 
Activities associated with inventory allocation, picking, packing, labeling, and shipment 
preparation. 
3.3 Dispatch 
The transfer of a packaged shipment from warehouse control to an approved carrier. 
3.4 Delivery Completion 
The successful transfer of goods to the customer or authorized recipient. 
3.5 Business Day 
Monday through Friday excluding company-recognized public holidays. 
3.6 SLA 
A measurable service commitment defining expected operational performance. 
3.7 Delivery Delay 
Any delivery occurring after the committed delivery date. 
3.8 SLA Breach

5. DELIVERY COMMITMENTS 
The company commits to: 
1. Accurate order processing. 
2. Timely shipment dispatch. 
3. Shipment visibility through tracking. 
4. Proactive delay notifications. 
5. Delivery confirmation recording. 
6. Continuous monitoring of delivery performance. 
All commitments are subject to exceptions described within this policy.
